'''Keerag''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. Both he and his brother [[Currsk]] were [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. After the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Deggar Feps]] angered the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Sonnos]], Feps attempted to travel from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], by gaining passage aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Lost Lady]]''. Keerag and Currsk also took up places on the ship, planning to find and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Feps.
